column3: Get up… Get up…. GET UP!
You need to save them… they don’t deserve this…
I’m tired of this fight, I’m too tired to move
You know what’s right… why won’t you do what’s right?
I can’t face them… all my friends… my family….
Don’t face them, fight for them. Stand _____
See, even the goop has entered your mind.
It's everywhere now, there's no way i could miss it.
Cross it… it's time we dealt with this
I have been waiting for this day…
I don’t know if I have the strength left.
I know you do. Avoiding them has left us weak but we can recover. We must bounce back. We HAVE to
